name: Shirogaku Misuken Man'yuutan ~Kyoto Yoru Genshou~
original_name: 白学ミス研漫遊譚～京都夜幻抄～
source:
There is a rumor about ghosts inhabiting the place in Kyoto where school trip stays for the night.
Members of the Mystery Research club try to explore these mysteries.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
